comment: Routes deliberately kept out of sitemap.xml and IndexNow. Single source of truth: app.routes.spec.ts asserts routes against it, and scripts/generate-sitemap-routes.mjs fails the build if it ever emits one. Both used to keep their own copy, which is how /seller and /seller-tool were removed from the committed JSON on 2026-08-03 and put straight back by the generator on the next build.
